variables.physical_definition: Material density, mass per unit volume of the metal.
Temperature difference between melting temperature and ambient temperature.
Laser beam radius, characteristic length scale of the laser spot.
Thermal diffusivity, rate of thermal diffusion through the material.
Effective laser power, energy delivered per unit time by the laser.
Heat capacity, amount of heat required to raise the temperature of a unit mass by one degree.
Laser scan speed, velocity at which the laser moves over the material surface.
